title: Introduce Explore Mode for column-resize and filter discovery in virtualized tables
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Problem: Our virtualized table supports column resizing and filters, but discovery and safe experimentation are poor for new users. Resizing gestures are fragile in high-density views, and users frequently over-scroll or mis-click when trying to find filter UIs.

Goal: Add an opt-in Explore Mode that temporarily relaxes virtualization and increases interactive affordances to let users preview column changes, discover filter options, and understand density tokens without committing changes. Explore Mode should be lightweight, reversible, keyboard-accessible, and compatible with existing column pinning and selection behavior.

Key constraints and principles:
- Minimal bundle impact: reuse tokens/components where possible; avoid adding new heavy dependencies.
- Backwards compatible: default behavior outside Explore Mode must be unchanged.
- Performance-aware: only relax virtualization for visible viewport + adjacent window; maintain 60fps for common hardware.
- Accessible: full keyboard traversal, ARIA announcements when virtualization toggles, focus management for temporary UI panels.
- Instrumented: telemetry hooks for entry/exit, resize attempts, abandonments, and filter adoption rates.

What Explore Mode provides (high level):
- Soft virtualization window: render visible rows + small buffer so inline column previews and filter flyouts position stably.
- Resize Explore: when resizing columns in Explore Mode show a persistent width overlay, snapless preview line, and a live cell-content fit indicator.
- Filter Discovery Panel: an inline quick-panel that surfaces active filter types for the visible columns, with example values and suggested presets.
- Density Tokens Inspector: a compact control showing the applied spacing token and a 3-step preview (Compact / Default / Comfortable) that applies only in Explore Mode.
- Safe apply: users can Accept (apply changes) or Dismiss (revert) with clear undo affordances in the toolbar.

Acceptance criteria:
- UX flows wireframes in Figma and interactive prototype exist and are reviewed by PM+Eng.
- Explore Mode toggle in table toolbar; toggling preserves scroll position and selection.
- Resize previews accurately reflect resulting column width across sample datasets (short/long content).
- Filter Discovery lists at least 3 suggested presets per column when data sample exists.
- Accessibility: keyboard-only users can enter Explore Mode, resize columns (via +/- arrow stepper), and apply/dismiss changes with ARIA live-region updates.
- Performance: measured 95th percentile frame time remains under 80ms in a 5k row sample when Explore Mode is active with buffer of 20 rows.
- Unit/integration tests in the component library validating state reconciliation between Explore Mode and normal mode.

Notes on relation to component library maintenance: this work touches tokens (density preview), core Button behavior (Accept/Dismiss), and table virtualization plumbing (render buffer). We'll propose small token additions but prefer re-mapping existing tokens before introducing new ones.
